title: Merge two unsorted arrays into one sorted array
answer: With the Stream API, I would convert both arrays to streams, concatenate them, sort the combined stream, and collect it back into an array: `IntStream.concat(Arrays.stream(first), Arrays.stream(second)).sorted().toArray()`. This works even when the original arrays are unsorted because sorting happens after concatenation. An imperative alternative is to allocate a combined array, copy both inputs into it with `System.arraycopy` or `Arrays.copyOf`, and call `Arrays.sort`. Both approaches are typically dominated by sorting cost, about O((n+m) log(n+m)).
